user_directive: Use the CED/public College Board laboratory guidance as the lab-source basis.

sources.title: AP Chemistry Course and Exam Description
sources.role: Course framework, science practices, laboratory expectations, and AP Chemistry scope.
governing_requirements: Minimum 25 percent of instructional time in laboratory investigations.
At least 6 of the 16 laboratory investigations conducted in guided-inquiry format.

sources.title: AP Chemistry Course Audit
sources.role: Current 2026-27 curricular and resource requirements for laboratory instruction.
governing_requirements: Laboratory investigations support required content and science-practice development.
Students record evidence of investigations in lab reports or notebooks and present evidence orally, in writing, or visually.
Students have access to AP Chemistry Guided Inquiry Experiments: Applying the Science Practices or other inquiry-based or student-directed activities that meet course objectives.
Virtual labs, simulations with student work, and safe home labs can satisfy hands-on laboratory time when circumstances prevent onsite access, with educator supervision and student records.

sources.title: What is a hands-on lab in an AP course?
sources.role: Public definition of hands-on and virtual laboratory experience for AP Course Audit.
governing_requirements: Students manipulate, observe, explore, and think about science using concrete materials in a hands-on experience.
Virtual laboratory experiences involve student interaction with computer-generated objects, data, or phenomena to fulfill laboratory learning objectives.
Teacher-led demonstrations alone do not count as hands-on or virtual laboratory experiences.

named_but_not_ingested_resource.title: AP Chemistry Guided Inquiry Experiments: Applying the Science Practices
named_but_not_ingested_resource.rule: Do not reproduce or attribute procedures from this manual unless the document is later supplied or otherwise lawfully available as a source.

mapping_policy.source_basis_scope: The public College Board guidance establishes laboratory requirements, inquiry expectations, supervision/recordkeeping expectations, and acceptable laboratory modalities. It does not prescribe a topic-by-topic teacher lab sequence.
mapping_policy.topic_mapping_method: Use the existing F0C experimental-reasoning priority to mark CED topics as core lab candidates, supporting lab candidates, or context-only topics. This is a project planning classification, not a College Board official lab assignment.
mapping_policy.procedure_rule: Do not invent or attribute College Board procedures. Later original laboratory activities may be authored from CED objectives, science practices, public Course Audit requirements, and source-supported chemistry.
mapping_policy.count_rule: A later Challenge Lab plan must select at least 16 hands-on investigations, including at least 6 guided-inquiry investigations, and maintain at least 25 percent laboratory instructional time.
mapping_policy.documentation_rule: Later lab experiences must include student evidence records and opportunities to communicate findings.
